request: When the Cloudflare proxied option is not set in the custom parameters, updating a record keeps the record's current proxy status: an unchanged IP sends no update at all, and a changed IP updates the address while leaving proxied as the record had it. Only an explicit proxied parameter changes it.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix(cloudflare): preserve proxy status when proxied is unset (#1740)

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > dns/cloudflare_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestCloudflareModifyProxied)$' ./dns >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
